requests.text: Compare the two supplied account rules. Identify supported facts and uncertain scope.

artifacts.text: Consumer-only manual creation is the overall rule. Business launch import contradicts it.
Business accounts may use launch import.

sources.text: New consumer accounts are created manually. New business accounts may use batch import at launch.
